usedFor: Shopify raises store events such as “New Product”, and Disqus receives a forum through “Create Forum”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Forum” in Disqus
bestTemplate.why: A new product gets its own comment space, created as a forum in Disqus.

watchOut: “Create Forum” in Disqus creates a new forum each time it runs, so check it fits the event.
